clinical_intent: A multi-institutional clinical trial protocol requires brachytherapy dose reporting per ICRU 89 format. One of the participating centers has been reporting doses using ICRU 38 point-based format instead. Calculate the potential impact on data quality for the trial, describe the corrective actions needed, and explain how to prevent similar protocol deviations in the future.
